findings.summary: Standard input is read with the console's input encoding, which on Windows is not UTF-8 when input is redirected, so text outside ASCII is miscounted: in the pull request's windows-latest check, 'é' (e and a combining accent) counted 3 characters, and 'café 世界 😀' counted 2 words and 19 characters. Read standard input as UTF-8 explicitly, as files already are.
The result is partial because the sandbox denied the test runner's local socket; the reviewer ran the suite outside the sandbox, and the pull request's checks run it on every platform.

body.summary: TALLY-01's first attempt: the counts, tests and README are right on Linux and macOS, where all 51 tests pass, but standard input is miscounted on Windows. Returned for another attempt.
